ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with approximately 5-8% high-intensity (white) punctate regions and linear disruptions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark base pigmentation with non-contiguous white focal spots distributed across both lobes; high-intensity, high-texture clusters concentrated at the lateral terminal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 60-degree interior angle and a depth of roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration across the entire trailing edge with prominent peaks (5-15 pixel amplitude) appearing most frequently on the distal thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature extending from the median notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous discrete, circular white pixel clusters (5-10 pixel diameter) distributed across the ventral field, particularly concentrated in the lower central region and right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical high-contrast scratch on the upper right lobe; multiple smaller diagonal and horizontal scratches visible on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-intensity, textured calcified masses (barnacle colonizations) and resulting tissue erosion at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, 'chewed' margin profile at the terminal ends of the trailing edge with associated tan/white encrustation.
